propositions: code-review-verify emits {verifications: [...]} with no decision polarity, causing all cases to be scored as advisory regardless of gold label
the _verdict_decision function keys only on verdict==FAIL or non-empty findings, neither of which the verifier emits, creating a guaranteed recall miss on V-real-defect (gold block)
treating non-empty verifications as block would fix the recall miss but simultaneously miscore V-clean-rename (gold advisory) as block, manufacturing a false accept
code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus as a polarity-free scorer, separate from the existing AGENTIC_SOLVERS exclusion to preserve the distinct reason and prevent future collapse
excluding both verify cases reduces n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20) and removes one symmetric recall miss from each arm without flipping any gating verdicts
